//: Each [Fact] in this assembly boots a throwaway Postgres container + a full WebApplicationFactory host (IAsyncLifetime per test instance). At xUnit's default parallelism (maxParallelThreads = CPU count) a 4-core CI runner runs 4+ such stacks concurrently, which exhausts the GitHub runner's 7 GB and kills the test host (MSB4166 'child node exited prematurely'). Capping collection parallelism at 2 keeps peak memory bounded while still overlapping container boots.
